findings.claim: CHANGELOG 0.29.0 states as an accomplished fact that reasoning_effort moved from the app's _REASONING_EFFORT_OVERRIDE to the gateway alias and that model swaps are now config-only, and that num_retries: 0 is set for the cheap aliases — but the delivered code already deletes the app-side override (litellm_client.py) while the paired gateway config change is, per IMP-633, NOT deployed on eco-dev (GET /model/info and md5sum both confirm the running config lacks it). The binding deploy-order instruction that prevents this from silently billing full reasoning effort ('do not deploy wan-api without _REASONING_EFFORT_OVERRIDE until the gateway is redeployed') exists only in backlog.md, not in any delivered file, gate, or migration step.
findings.fix: Either gate the removal of _REASONING_EFFORT_OVERRIDE on the gateway config actually being deployed (verified in an automated check, not prose), or revert the CHANGELOG claim to state the migration is only code-ready and not yet in effect, and encode the required deploy order as an executable precondition rather than a backlog paragraph.
